uncertain_points.claim: The enum app_mux_sel_e has specific 5-bit encodings (5'b10100, 5'b11001, 5'b00010, 5'b01111) without comments explaining the purpose or correlation to hardware mux selections.
uncertain_points.risk: Potential misunderstanding of mux selection mapping, leading to incorrect data routing if values are misapplied.

uncertain_points.claim: The enum app_mux_sel_e has width 5, defining only 4 out of 32 possible encodings. The remaining 28 values are unspecified, and any use of this type as a mux select without a default case could lead to undefined behavior.
uncertain_points.cond: When a signal of type app_mux_sel_e is used to control a multiplexer without a default or safe fallback.
uncertain_points.risk: Potential X-propagation, latch-up, or selection of unintended data path, possibly exposing sensitive data.
